findings: Approximately 47.8 to 49.2 GB of host-MemAvailable minus CUDA-free discrepancy was already present before this run checkpoint hash, while native allocated/reserved/inactive-split were all zero. This cannot be solely this allocator fragmentation.

Actual12 A hash intent gap47797968896B became47799451648B after hash, +1482752B. Actual13 A hash intent gap49187880960B became49189294080B, +1413120B. These warm preconditions do not show that the current hash created the large discrepancy, and cannot identify cache ancestry.

Actual13 A vs actual12 A hash-intent gap was already1389912064B larger. First-forward-complete gap was1389109248B larger, a difference of only802816B from the baseline gap change. The first-forward CUDA-free decline1669500928B includes reserved increase272629760B; the comparison is not an isolated allocator experiment.

Post-forward inactive_split551153664B in actual12 A versus823816192B in actual13 A is genuine measured difference; maxsplit128 did not establish capacity. Neither this difference nor current cache counters prove checkpoint attribution.

Existing root observation reports vram_free13268152534 minus torch_vram_free224194774 equals host MemFree13043957760B exactly, while MemAvailable39004987392B and Cached26030141440B differ. This is consistent with the documented free-vs-reclaimable distinction; installed ComfyUI source identity was not independently established here.

Closed native source host_memory recorded only MemTotal/MemAvailable/SwapTotal/SwapFree, so no retrospective MemFree/Cached decomposition is possible. cgroup file is not global page cache attribution, and global/per-process/native allocator axes must remain distinct.

primary_docs.finding: Spark CPU/GPU share DRAM; cudaMemGetInfo can understate allocatable capacity because it excludes potential reclamation. Vendor debugging text is not authorization to mutate system cache. Keep existing no-swap-credit and original gates.
cudaMemGetInfo free is OS-reported free device memory, not an allocation guarantee; multi-tenant values race and UMA excludes swap. Current13.4 docs describe API, not exact installed CUDA13.0 binary.
MemAvailable estimates memory usable without swapping from MemFree, reclaimable slab, file LRU and watermarks. Cached also includes tmpfs/shmem; it is not identical to reclaimable file bytes.
Returns one low-bit residency entry per page for mapped address range; result can stale immediately. Page counts and exact final partial-page file bytes differ.
Modern tool uses cachestat with mincore fallback; use explicit output fields. Its short no-write warning omits owner exception visible in upstream mincore source.
Linux6.5+ file range cache stats avoid a virtual mapping but depend on syscall availability/permission; not selected because parent requested explicit mincore-only source.

Upstream get_free_memory CUDA branch returns mem_get_info free plus reserved-minus-active; subtraction of torch_vram_free reconstructs underlying CUDA estimate when installed code matches. Upstream tag is not installed source provenance.

decision_before_implementation.decision: Small independently written standard-library ctypes probe in its own artifact namespace, using the existing original ResourceGate CPU implementation unchanged and externally SHA pinned. Reference API/design only; no source-code copying from GPL/BSD projects. No new installed package or runtime dependency.
required_contract: Default dry; explicit --run plus reviewed sourceSHA and planSHA for actual invocation.
Exact fixed23919549408B blob from fixed pinned snapshot symlink; regular fd read-only NOFOLLOW; euid must own inode so mincore output cannot silently be fabricated. Retain mode0400.
256MiB page-aligned PROT_NONE/MAP_PRIVATE windows; <=64KiB residency vector; do not dereference mapping, read/pread/hash checkpoint, touch/cacheadvise or load model/framework/GPU.
Fresh durable unchanged original CPU gate before open, before each map and after measurement; sameboot zero credit; no relaxed threshold.
Stable before/after path and fd identity; oneinode only despite nlink2; fsynced bounded fresh output, UNKNOWN on error, no retry, unmap/close in finally.

Metrics include host free/available/cache/slab and process IO/majorfault counters beforeafter, without claiming counters alone prove no payload reads. No reclaimability/allocation/training/task-quality conclusion.
